interest: Tracks Japanese plans to build factories in Uruguay's free port.
overview: 1934 docket: a Japanese consortium sought factories in Uruguay's Free Port of Colonia; State set aside the tariff inquiry.

subfiles.about: State Department list of papers indexing correspondence on a proposed Japanese industrial consortium investment in the Free Port of Colonia, Uruguay.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a 1934 despatch on a Japanese bid for factories in Uruguay's Colonia port, and instructions dropping a tariff inquiry.
